title: Winter Jam
seo_title: Winter Jam 2027 Christian Music Night with Crowder
description: Winter Jam 2027 is an evening of Christian music and worship featuring Crowder, Anne Wilson, Andy Mineo ft. Magic & Bird, Strings & Heart, Terrian, Red, and NewSong, plus a message from speaker Zane Black. A Pre-Jam Party with Natural State, CJ Emulous, and Mary-Clair starts things off, and General Admission doors open at 6:00pm. No advance tickets are needed; entry is a $15 donation at the door, and parking is $20 ($50 premium).
price: $15 donation at the door; parking $20 ($50 premium)
